method: per-channel RGB mean and population standard deviation (divide by N) from all 100000 original training images, decoded once with PIL Image.open(path).convert('RGB'), scaled to [0,1], float64 accumulation, computed before augmentation/padding/tail dropping; validation and test images never used; mean = S/N; std = sqrt(max(0, E[x^2] - mean^2)); constants stored as float32
reduction: per-image float64 channel sums and sums-of-squares accumulated sequentially in canonical train order (wnids.txt order, sorted filenames); no parallel reduction
canonical_train_order: classes in wnids.txt order (class index = 0-based position), then files sorted with Python sorted() (Unicode code point order) inside train/<wnid>/images/ filtered to *.jpeg/*.JPEG case-insensitively
